description: Fetch a single YouTube video by id via SerpAPI: details, related videos, comments and replies. `v` is the video id from a youtube_search video_results entry. Page related videos / comments / replies with next_page_token from a prior result.

gl.description: Country code for the search, e.g. 'us', 'uk', 'de'.

next_page_token.description: Token from a prior result to page through related videos, comments, or replies.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh SerpAPI fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

v.description: YouTube video id (required), e.g. the id from a youtube_search video_results entry.

zero_trace.description: Enterprise-only ZeroTrace mode: don't store search params/metadata on SerpAPI. Default false.

name: youtube_video
title: Get YouTube Video (SerpAPI)
